description: This Java class provides utility methods for working with Proton AMQP links and sessions within the Eclipse Hono project, including handling link detach/close events, executing code on specific Vert.x contexts, and managing link lifecycle.

classes.name: HonoProtonHelper
classes.description: Final utility class with static methods for managing Proton links and sessions in Vert.x environment.

methods.name: setDetachHandler
methods.description: Sets a handler for remote detach frames with close property false, frees link after handling.

methods.name: setCloseHandler
methods.description: Sets a handler for remote detach frames with close property true, frees link after handling.

methods.name: setDefaultCloseHandler (link)
methods.description: Sets default close handler on a link to respond with detach and free resources.

methods.name: setDefaultCloseHandler (session)
methods.description: Sets default close handler on a session to close and free resources.

methods.name: isLinkEstablished
methods.description: Checks if a Proton link is established based on remote source/target.

methods.name: executeOrRunOnContext
methods.description: Executes code on a specified Vert.x context, handling context switching.

methods.name: closeAndFree (link, handler)
methods.description: Closes a link and frees resources after a default timeout.

methods.name: closeAndFree (link, timeout, handler)
methods.description: Closes a link, waits for detach or timeout, then frees resources.
